title: NFT Gallery & Print File Upload
tagline: To create a basic NFT Art Marketplace that incorporates a JS based NFT and print options
description: We have created a basic Zora NFT Art Marketplace that incorporates a JS based NFT and some print options. We integrated Zora with NFS.Storage instead of fleek for file storage. Casey's NFTs are dynamically created from JS files based on one days worth of user data (User Capital) and he is showcasing them here on the front page.
how_its_made: We used Zora.gallery linked to Caseys Zora account where he demos his User Capital NFT showing the events of a single day on the internet. We have used NFT.Storage in replace of fleek on our Zora gallery, and hope to save the print files, web files as a single directory CID to save gas. The create screen includes a field for print that would upload files to the directory and would eventually be encoded so only the printer could access.
